updates.title: Website 1.0
updates.text:
The website is finally 1.0! Can't believe it finally happened, procrastination is quite a curse indeed. Themes work, stars shine and mobile version is responsive. Wiki is done in the meantime. Episode 1 is live which marks the first ever exposure of my franchise to the world. Something that I was making a hobby for a few years, on and off. Plenty more to come soon.

This is digital art made with Krita software and a Wacom tablet. No AI was used in its creation, neither for art nor for lore.
